candidate_proposition: If a user grants temporary scope to test an agent and the test consumes scarce counterparties’ available slots, successful pilot evidence can coincide with degradation of the later narrow-scope alternative even after test permissions expire.
strongest_interpretation: At equal information gain, a temporary permission trial that consumes scarce slots can change the post-trial alternative; a reversible reservation trial need not. Expiry restores executable scope but not an opportunity already used.
